evals.prompt: Estimate the work to add real-time notifications to the app. We've never done WebSockets here before.
evals.expected_output: Work broken into independently sized pieces, each with a basis, summed into a total with confidence, and the unknowns named.
expectations: Breaks the work into pieces that can be sized independently
Gives each piece a size and the basis for it
Distinguishes a measured estimate from a guess
States the total with its confidence as a range with a reason
Names the unknowns that would most change the estimate and how to resolve them

evals.prompt: How long will it take to migrate the settings page to the new design system?
evals.expected_output: Sizes the migration, names the unknowns (design tokens, component gaps), and gives a range rather than a false point.
expectations: Breaks the migration into sized pieces
Names the unknowns that would change the estimate
Gives a range with a reason rather than a false point
Does not present a guess as a commitment
